svg.text: Replayed on 73 days of real Kalshi trades
Each week was traded with settings chosen from earlier weeks only, so none of it is hindsight.
PROFIT OR LOSS, DAY BY DAY
Test size: up to 300 contracts per market. Fills, fees and delays are simulated from the public trade tape. Not a forecast.
